title: Six-class secp256k1 rho at 125.834439: 256-walk product loops on the exact-accounting package

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold six-class negation-plus-GLV parallel rho algorithm in proof.md and upstream-proof.md stops on every run within 2^125.834439 target-group-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit). Under disclosed heuristic H1, correction-borrow premise C and 2-cycle premise P1, its recovery probability is at least 0.39000001. For each fresh trail of length L, C bounds expected dx, dy, u borrow counts by (1/2+2^-10)E[L], (1/2+2^-11)E[L], (1/2+2^-11)E[L]; P1 bounds expected caught 2-cycles by E[L]/(4R). Parameters: M=2^23, R=2^26, kappa=1.0001, p0=0.39001172, h=0.0000116. Memory <2^72 bytes; preprocessing capped at 2^59 units and included; no advice. The direct base is 7680a8ca; 671caf26 supplies 256-walk grouping, 59498c9 exact tail/anchor accounting, b14e7c12 the walk and baseline budget, and 34a30cf5 the correction account. CORR=73875/16384=PREM+51/16384 is charged per walk; certificate.py checks its concentration margin and work cap. The declared time-limited initial experiment and certificate were run separately; see evidence.md for actual scope and earlier snapshots. This is an analytic heuristic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Check production identities, a time-limited toy pipeline, interpreter execution of the shipped kernels and exits against reference arithmetic, counts, ledger and census rules. This is not a production-scale attack; evidence.md describes limitations.
